info.name: Property Management System API
info.description:
Internal property listing backend. Roles: `sales` (Marketing) and `admin`. Customers are guests without an account: they use only the public (unauthenticated) property endpoints and contact Marketing through WhatsApp.

**Privacy contract**
- Owner PII is served only by `GET /properties/{id}/owner` to the *primary marketing* of that listing.
- Exact address (block, cluster, street, house, floor, room) and coordinates are returned only to the
  primary marketing and to co-listing marketing of that listing (same view, `access_level` tells which).
- Other marketing, admin and guests never receive them; nobody except the primary marketing ever receives owner data.
- Admin records the outcome of a property (`POST /properties/{id}/deal` or `/cancel`) and manages co-listing; Admin never edits listings.
- The representing marketing user's WhatsApp contact (`contact`) is public; the owner's number never is.
- Identity and role always come from the verified bearer token, never from request bodies.

**Rate limits** (per IP): every request 300/min (`API_RATE_LIMIT_*`), login/refresh 5/min, uploads 30/min.
Exceeding a limit returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header. Every response carries `X-Request-ID`.

**Error envelope**: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": [...] }`.
Unauthorized access to an existing, visible resource returns 403; resources hidden from the caller
(draft/archived listings, another marketing's deal or commission) return 404.

item.name: Universal login (email + password only; the backend returns the role)

request.description: Self-service: changes only the caller's own whatsapp_number (D-033). Empty string clears it.

item.name: Search listings (public for guests; role-scoped for Marketing/Admin)

request.description:
Guests and marketing without a relationship to a listing receive only `available`/`reserved` listings; `status` is ignored for them.
`history=true` returns the sold/rented historical section (never mixed with available listings).
`(page-1)*limit` must not exceed 10000 and at most 20 `facility_ids` are accepted (422 otherwise).
Admin may filter by any `status`. Marketing may use `scope=mine` or `scope=co_listing`. `archived` (cancelled) listings are
excluded from every list unless `status=archived` is requested explicitly by Admin or Marketing.
List items never contain owner data, exact address or coordinates.

item.name: Create a listing (Marketing only; actor becomes primary owner)

request.description: `primary_marketing_id` and `owner_id` are not accepted. The owner is created from the nested `owner` object.

item.name: Property detail (projection depends on the caller)

request.description:
- primary marketing and co-listing marketing → `PrimaryProperty` (restricted address, coordinates, team; no owner data)
- admin → `InternalProperty` (no restricted data, no owner data)
- everyone else → `PublicProperty` (404 for draft/maintenance/archived)
`contact.whatsapp_url` is public and always uses the representing marketing user's number.
`PUT` is kept as an alias. Code, owner and primary marketing cannot be changed.

item.name: Delete (primary marketing only); archives instead when the property has a deal
Set status manually (primary marketing; co-listing marketing limited)

request.description:
Primary: draft, available, reserved, maintenance, archived. Co-listing marketing: only available, reserved,
maintenance, and never on a draft/archived listing. `sold` and `rented` are set only when Admin records a deal.

item.name: Upload image (primary marketing only; type sniffed, size limited)
Owner PII (primary marketing of this listing only)
Update owner (primary marketing of this listing only)
List ownership documents (primary and co-listing marketing only)

request.description: Metadata only; file paths are never returned. Admin, other marketing and guests get 403/401.

item.name: Upload (or replace) an ownership document (primary marketing only)

request.description:
Allowed only while the matching `cert_*` flag of the property is `true`, and only for document types that apply
to the property type (house: shm, hgb, imb, pbb, girik, other; apartment: shmsrs, hgb, imb, pbb, slf, other;
shop_house: shm, hgb, imb, pbb, slf, other; factory: shm, hgb, hgu, imb, pbb, slf, other). PDF, JPEG or PNG
(sniffed from content), at most `UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE`. One document per type: uploading again replaces it.
Files are stored privately and are not reachable under `/uploads`.

item.name: Download an ownership document (primary and co-listing marketing only; audited)
Delete an ownership document (primary marketing only)
Marketing team (admin, primary marketing, co-listing members)

request.description: Transactional with a property row lock. User must be active with role `sales`; max 2 co-listing (3 total).

Admin moves primary ownership to another active marketing user (marketing asks the admin, e.g. via WhatsApp).
The previous primary becomes a co-listing member, so a free co-listing slot is required when the new primary
is not already in the team. Owner data follows the listing to the new primary. Not an edit of listing content.

item.name: Replace a co-listing marketing (admin only); body holds the replacement
Remove a co-listing marketing (admin only; primary cannot be removed)
Record a deal on a property (admin only)

request.description:
Marketing reports a deal to Admin outside the system; Admin records it here. In one transaction: the
property becomes `sold` (sale) or `rented` (rent), a pending commission is created for the property's primary
marketing (default percentage) and an audit entry is written. `type` must match the listing's transaction type.
A property accepts exactly one outcome (deal or cancellation); a second attempt returns 409.

item.name: Record that the owner no longer sells or rents the property (admin only)

request.description:
The property becomes `archived` and disappears from every list (public, marketing and admin lists) and from
guest detail views. No commission is created. Returns 409 if the property already has an outcome.

item.name: Deals and cancellations. Marketing → own listings only; admin → all
Deal or cancellation detail (404 for another marketing's deal)
Commission detail (404 for another marketing's commission)
Override the percentage of a pending commission (admin only); amount is recalculated from the deal price
Mark a pending commission paid or cancelled (admin only; final states are immutable)
Create a Marketing or Admin account (admin only; there is no self-registration)
Change role (admin); nobody can change their own role
